speaker: Doctor

DIAGNOSIS READY: Clostridioides difficile infection (C. diff).

Given your recent use of levofloxacin and severe watery diarrhea with cramping, I suspect antibiotic-associated colitis. I have already requested relevant test results; please await confirmation while we monitor your hydration status.
